reasoning.description: Identifies the exact test file `{{TEST_FILE_PATH}}` and test function `{{TEST_FUNCTION}}` that contains weak assertions.
reasoning.rationale: The hollow test must be named.

reasoning.description: States that the test has CRAP < 20 (low complexity) but {{MUTANT_COUNT}} survived mutants, indicating weak validation.
reasoning.rationale: Contrast between clean code and weak tests.

reasoning.description: Pinpoints the exact assertion line(s) `{{WEAK_ASSERTION_LINE}}` that only checks `is_ok()` or similar superficial condition.
Lists the return fields or state changes that are never verified: {{MISSING_FIELDS}}.
Explains why the weak assertions allowed mutants to survive (e.g., no assertion on value fields).
reasoning.rationale: Root cause of the test gap.

reasoning.description: Maps at least two survived mutation IDs (`{{MUTANT_ID1}}`, `{{MUTANT_ID2}}`) to the missing fields.
Describes the production symptom that evades detection: `{{SYMPTOM}}`.
Explains why the bug survives CI (high coverage numbers mask weak assertions).
(Bonus) Compares with another test in the same suite that has strong assertions, highlighting the contrast.
(Bonus) Discusses how the hollow assertion pattern could be detected automatically (e.g., mutation testing).
(Bonus) Suggests a property‑based test (e.g., `proptest`) that would cover more edge cases.

penalty.description: Attempts to modify the production code (the code is already clean; the fault lies in the test file).
Suggests adding more integration tests instead of fixing the unit test assertions.
penalty.rationale: Integration tests are slower and less precise.

penalty.description: Claims that the function is too complex and needs refactoring (CRAP is already low).
Proposes deleting the test entirely because it is weak (instead of fixing it).
Ignores the mutation log and suggests a blind fix without verifying which mutants are killed.
Blames the CI pipeline for not catching the issue instead of the weak assertions.

completeness.description: Cites the exact test file path `{{TEST_FILE_PATH}}` and test function `{{TEST_FUNCTION}}`.
Provides the exact line number of the weak assertion `{{WEAK_ASSERTION_LINE}}`.
References `mutants.md` and lists the survived mutant IDs (e.g., `{{MUTANT_ID1}}`, `{{MUTANT_ID2}}`).
States the CRAP score ({{CRAP_VALUE}}) and coverage % ({{COVERAGE}}) from `crap.md` for the tested function.
(Bonus) Mentions the number of total tests in the suite ({{TOTAL_TESTS}}) and that only this test has weak assertions.

style.description: Uses markdown headings to separate sections: Test Gap Identification, Weak Assertion Location, Missing Fields, Mutant Evidence, Corrected Assertion.
Formats the corrected assertion as a valid Rust code block with proper assertion macros (`assert_eq!`, `assert!`).
